sloka: यास्त्वया विधवा राजन् कृता नैकाः कुलस्त्रियः ।पतिव्रता धर्मपरा गुरुशुश्रूषणे रताः ।ताभिः शोकाभितप्ताभिः शप्तः परवशं गतः ।। ६.११४.६५ ।।
transliteration: yāstvayā vidhavā rājan kṛtā naikāḥ kulastriyaḥ ।pativratā dharmaparā guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ ।tābhiḥ śokābhitaptābhiḥ śaptaḥ paravaśaṁ gataḥ ।। 6.114.65 ।।

translations.english: "These people who were with you are always sporting my Lord. Why do you not call them, why are you not consoling them, or inviting them?"
